# Do I owe tax on my savings interest?

> Free UK savings interest tax calculator: how much tax you owe on bank and building society interest after the personal allowance, the 0% starting rate for savings and the Personal Savings Allowance, how much you can earn tax-free, and what a cash ISA would save. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
